initProvider.description:
THIS IS A BETA FIELD. It will be honored
unless the Management Policies feature flag is disabled.
InitProvider holds the same fields as ForProvider, with the exception
of Identifier and other resource reference fields. The fields that are
in InitProvider are merged into ForProvider when the resource is created.
The same fields are also added to the terraform ignore_changes hook, to
avoid updating them after creation. This is useful for fields that are
required on creation, but we do not desire to update them after creation,
for example because of an external controller is managing them, like an
autoscaler.

streamNames.description: Names of the in-application streams created for the input.

lastUpdateTimestamp.description: Timestamp when the application was last updated.

outputs.description: Output destination configuration of the application. See outputs Block below for details.

id.description: ARN of the Kinesis Analytics Application.

resourceArn.description: ARN of the Kinesis Firehose delivery stream.

roleArn.description: ARN of the IAM Role used to access the stream.

kinesisStream.description: Kinesis Stream configuration for the destination stream. Conflicts with kinesis_firehose. See outputs.kinesis_stream Block below for details.

roleArn.description: ARN of the IAM Role used to access the stream.

lambda.description: Lambda function destination. See outputs.lambda Block below for details.

roleArn.description: ARN of the IAM Role used to access the Lambda function.

schema.description: Schema format of the data written to the destination. See outputs.schema Block below for details.

recordFormatType.description: Format Type of the records on the output stream. Can be CSV or JSON.

id.description: ARN of the Kinesis Analytics Application.

s3.description: S3 configuration for the reference data source. See reference_data_sources.s3 Block below for details.

fileKey.description: File Key name containing reference data.

roleArn.description: IAM Role ARN to read the data.

schema.description: Schema format of the data in the streaming source. See reference_data_sources.schema Block below for details.

recordColumns.description: Record Column mapping for the streaming source data element. See reference_data_sources.schema.record_columns Block below for details.

mapping.description: Mapping reference to the data element.

recordEncoding.description: Encoding of the record in the streaming source.

recordFormat.description: Record Format and mapping information to schematize a record. See reference_data_sources.schema.record_format Block below for details.

mappingParameters.description: Mapping Information for the record format. See reference_data_sources.schema.record_format.mapping_parameters Block below for details.

csv.description: Mapping information when the record format uses delimiters. See reference_data_sources.schema.record_format.mapping_parameters.csv Block below for details.

json.description: Mapping information when JSON is the record format on the streaming source. See reference_data_sources.schema.record_format.mapping_parameters.json Block below for details.

recordRowPath.description: Path to the top-level parent that contains the records.

recordFormatType.description: Type of Record Format of the reference data source.

region.description:
Region where this resource will be managed. Defaults to the Region set in the provider configuration.
Region is the region you'd like your resource to be created in.

startApplication.description: Whether to start or stop the Kinesis Analytics Application. To start an application, an input with a defined starting_position must be configured. To modify an application's starting position, first stop the application by setting start_application = false, then update starting_position and set start_application = true.

tagsAll.description: Map of tags assigned to the resource, including those inherited from the provider default_tags configuration block.

items.description: A Condition that may apply to a resource.

lastTransitionTime.description:
LastTransitionTime is the last time this condition transitioned from one
status to another.

message.description:
A Message containing details about this condition's last transition from
one status to another, if any.

observedGeneration.description:
ObservedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description: A Reason for this condition's last transition from one status to another.

status.description: Status of this condition; is it currently True, False, or Unknown?

type.description:
Type of this condition. At most one of each condition type may apply to
a resource at any point in time.

lastHandledReconcileAt.description:
LastHandledReconcileAt holds the value of the most recent
reconcile-requested-at annotation token that the controller has
processed. Users can compare this to the annotation to determine
whether a reconcile request has been handled.

observedGeneration.description:
ObservedGeneration is the latest metadata.generation
which resulted in either a ready state, or stalled due to error
it can not recover from without human intervention.
